label: default_jungletree_top
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for the exposed end-grain of a massive old jungle tree in a humid grounded dark-fantasy world. The wood grew quickly but unevenly under relentless heat, rain and competition. Let broad growth bands compress and wander around a deep moisture-darkened heartwood, with subtle radial checking, old staining and fibrous end-grain that feels dense with stored water and age. It should carry the biological heaviness of a rainforest giant rather than the neat geometry of sawn lumber. Use subdued warm brown, deep umber and damp muted ochre. Avoid perfect target-like rings, decorative spirals, giant cracks, glossy fresh-cut wood or a clean forestry specimen. Treat this as a material study of jungle end-grain and growth history. Establish weight, humidity and age without reproducing any game-texture composition.
